Curated Social is a template-based social media tool for real estate agents. Paid plans (from $25/mo billed annually) unlock the Content Vault of shared templates you can edit in Canva; the Pro plan's Autopilot schedules and posts them for you. The Elite plan ($297/month) adds a dedicated rep who posts for you, but content still comes from the same shared library. Platforms are limited to Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, and LinkedIn. No video editing. No custom local content.

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

Is Curated Social a done-for-you service?

Partly: the Pro plan's Autopilot posts for you automatically, and the $297/month concierge plan adds a dedicated rep. Paid plans (from $25/month billed annually) give you a Content Vault of pre-made templates; on Pro, Autopilot schedules and posts them for you.
Does Curated Social include video editing?
No. Curated Social focuses entirely on static graphics and templates. There is no video editing or short-form video production on any plan.
Which platforms does Curated Social post to?
Curated Social posts to Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, and LinkedIn. There is no support for Google Business Profile, TikTok, YouTube, or Pinterest.
Does Curated Social create custom content for my brand?

No. Curated Social provides a shared library of pre-made templates. You can add a branding bar with your photo and logo, but the underlying graphics are the same templates used by every other agent on the platform. VEXI makes graphics in your own brand.
